Technical SEO.

Make important pages easier for search engines to discover, load and index across WordPress, Shopify and custom websites.

Discuss this service View brief

Scope of work.

Crawling and structure

We inspect crawl rules, sitemaps, canonical tags and redirect chains. We also review navigation, breadcrumbs and internal links to the pages that matter.

Speed and structured data

We examine mobile loading and layout stability, optimise heavy resources and validate markup against what each page actually contains.

Changes and migrations

Developers receive an ordered set of fixes or a migration map. We re-crawl after implementation and monitor the new site for regressions.

What you receive.

  • Crawl findings and development tickets ordered by impact.
  • Redirect mapping and pre-launch checks for a migration.
  • A verification crawl, with post-launch monitoring for migrations.

Common questions.

Which platforms do you support?

The team works on WordPress, Shopify and custom sites. Platform-specific checks can include theme performance, plugins and caching.

Can our developer implement the fixes?

Yes. We can write the tickets, discuss the changes and test the result after deployment.

Can the scope cover multilingual websites?

Yes. International projects can include language targeting and hreflang review when that is relevant to the site.
